ready1_open_rewrite.raw_question_text: As shown in the figure: It is known that $O$ is a point on line $CD$, $OA$ bisects $\angle BOC$, $\angle AOC=40^\circ$, find the degree measure of $\angle BOD$.
ready1_open_rewrite.raw_answer_text:
\textbf{Solution:} Given that $O$ is a point on the line $CD$, and $OA$ bisects $\angle BOC$, $\angle AOC=40^\circ$,\\
then $\angle BOC=2\angle AOC=80^\circ$,\\
thus $\angle BOD=180^\circ-\angle BOC=\boxed{100^\circ}$.
